# PhoenixmlDb Documentation

> PhoenixmlDb Documentation — documentation site

- [Home](https://phoenixml.dev/index.html): PhoenixmlDb — Modern XML/JSON document database for .NET
- [Release Notes](https://phoenixml.dev/release-notes.html): PhoenixmlDb version history and changelog

## api

- [ContainerId](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/containerid.html): A lightweight, strongly-typed identifier for a container within a PhoenixmlDb database.
- [ContainerInfo](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/containerinfo.html): Summary information about a container, returned by .
- [ContainerNotFoundException](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/containernotfoundexception.html): Thrown when a container with the specified name does not exist in the database.
- [ContainerOptions](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/containeroptions.html): Configuration options for an , controlling indexing, namespace bindings, validation, and whitespace handling.
- [ContentType](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/contenttype.html): Specifies the content format of a stored document.
- [DatabaseStatistics](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/databasestatistics.html): Aggregate statistics for a PhoenixmlDb database.
- [DayTimeDuration](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/daytimeduration.html): Represents an xs:dayTimeDuration value as a total seconds count using precision, supporting arbitrarily large durations.
- [DcTerms](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/dcterms.html): Dublin Core Terms (http://purl.org/dc/terms/), the standard document-metadata vocabulary.
- [DocumentExistsException](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/documentexistsexception.html): Thrown when attempting to store a document with a name that already exists and is set to false.
- [DocumentId](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/documentid.html): A lightweight, strongly-typed identifier for a document within a container.
- [DocumentInfo](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/documentinfo.html): Lightweight summary information about a stored document, returned by and .
- [DocumentInput](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/documentinput.html): One document to write in a batch: name, content, and optional per-document options.
- [DocumentNotFoundException](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/documentnotfoundexception.html): Thrown when a document with the specified name does not exist in the container.
- [DocumentOptions](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/documentoptions.html): Options controlling how a document is stored when calling .
- [DocumentParseException](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/documentparseexception.html): Thrown when document content cannot be parsed as well-formed XML or valid JSON.
- [FullTextIndexDefinition](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/fulltextindexdefinition.html): Defines a full-text index that tokenizes text content for ft:contains() search.
- [FullTextIndexOptions](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/fulltextindexoptions.html): Controls tokenization and text analysis for full-text indexes created via .
- [IContainer](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/icontainer.html): Primary interaction surface for storing, retrieving, querying, and managing documents within a PhoenixmlDb container.
- [IDocument](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/idocument.html): Represents a stored document retrieved from a container, providing access to its content, parsed XDM node tree, and application-defined metadata.
- [IDocumentDatabase](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/idocumentdatabase.html): Root entry point for all PhoenixmlDb operations.
- [PhoenixmlDb.Core API Reference](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/index.html): API documentation for the PhoenixmlDb.Core library
- [IndexConfiguration](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/indexconfiguration.html): Provides a fluent API for defining the indexes that accelerate XQuery and metadata queries on a container's documents.
- [IndexDefinition](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/indexdefinition.html): Abstract base type for all index definitions. Each concrete subtype represents a different index strategy.
- [IReadTransaction](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/ireadtransaction.html): A read-only transaction that provides MVCC snapshot isolation over the database.
- [IWriteTransaction](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/iwritetransaction.html): A read-write transaction providing full ACID guarantees for atomic multi-document operations.
- [IXdmNode](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/ixdmnode.html): Represents a node in the XQuery Data Model (XDM) tree — the parsed, structured representation of a stored XML or JSON document.
- [IXmlResourceResolver](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/ixmlresourceresolver.html): Host-injectable seam for resolving the resources referenced by an XInclude xi:include element (href, optionally combined with parse).
- [LocalFileResourceResolver](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/localfileresourceresolver.html): Default implementation: resolves file: (local filesystem) URIs directly and, unless is set, blocks any other scheme (e.g. http:, https:) as a security precaution against server-side-request-forgery via xi:include href.
- [MetadataCollection](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/metadatacollection.html): All metadata for one document, keyed by qualified name.
- [MetadataCollectionExtensions](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/metadatacollectionextensions.html): Typed access to a .
- [MetadataIndexDefinition](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/metadataindexdefinition.html): Defines a metadata index that enables efficient queries by document metadata key-value pairs.
- [MetadataProperty`1](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/metadataproperty-1.html): A typed, discoverable handle on one metadata name in one namespace.
- [NameIndexDefinition](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/nameindexdefinition.html): Defines a name index that accelerates element and attribute name lookups.
- [NamespaceBinding](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/namespacebinding.html): A namespace prefix-to-URI binding, representing a single xmlns:prefix="uri" declaration on an element.
- [NamespaceId](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/namespaceid.html): A lightweight, strongly-typed identifier for an interned namespace URI.
- [NamespaceRegistry](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/namespaceregistry.html): The single source of truth mapping well-known values to their URIs and conventional prefixes.
- [NodeId](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/nodeid.html): A lightweight, strongly-typed identifier for a node within a document's XDM tree.
- [ParseResult](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/parseresult.html): The result of parsing an XML document via .
- [PathIndexDefinition](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/pathindexdefinition.html): Defines a path index that accelerates evaluation of XPath path expressions.
- [PhxMeta](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/phxmeta.html): Engine-reserved document metadata (https://schemas.phoenixml.dev/2026/meta).
- [QName](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/qname.html): Represents a qualified name (QName) consisting of a namespace, a local name, and an optional prefix — the XDM representation of element and attribute names.
- [TextNodeItem](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/textnodeitem.html): Lightweight text node marker for XSLT sequence accumulators, distinguishing text nodes from atomic string values.
- [TransactionException](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/transactionexception.html): Thrown when a transaction operation fails due to an invalid state or internal error.
- [TransactionTimeoutException](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/transactiontimeoutexception.html): Thrown when a write transaction cannot be acquired within the specified timeout period.
- [Utf8StringWriter](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/utf8stringwriter.html): A that reports its encoding as UTF-8.
- [ValidationMode](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/validationmode.html): Specifies how documents should be validated when stored in a container.
- [ValueIndexDefinition](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/valueindexdefinition.html): Defines a value index that stores typed values for range queries and comparisons.
- [XdmAttribute](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xdmattribute.html): Represents an XML attribute node in the XDM tree.
- [XdmComment](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xdmcomment.html): Represents an XML comment node (<!-- ... -->) in the XDM tree.
- [XdmDocument](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xdmdocument.html): Represents an XML document root node in the XDM tree.
- [XdmElement](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xdmelement.html): Represents an XML element node in the XDM tree, including its attributes, children, and namespace declarations.
- [XdmNamespace](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xdmnamespace.html): Represents a namespace node in the XDM tree, corresponding to an in-scope namespace binding on an element.
- [XdmNode](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xdmnode.html): Abstract base class for all XDM (XPath Data Model) nodes, representing the in-memory structure of XML and JSON documents as defined by the W3C XDM specification.
- [XdmNodeKind](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xdmnodekind.html): Enumerates the seven node kinds defined by the XQuery Data Model (XDM) specification, plus as a sentinel value.
- [XdmProcessingInstruction](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xdmprocessinginstruction.html): Represents an XML processing instruction (<?target data?>) in the XDM tree.
- [XdmQName](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xdmqname.html): Represents an expanded QName (namespace URI + local name + optional prefix), as used throughout the XDM for node names, type names, and function names.
- [XdmSequence](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xdmsequence.html): An ordered sequence of XDM items — the public wire-format for passing values between transformations and queries without serializing through XML markup.
- [XdmText](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xdmtext.html): Represents a text node containing character data content in the XDM tree.
- [XdmType](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xdmtype.html): Enumeration of XDM atomic value types, corresponding to the XML Schema (XSD) type hierarchy.
- [XdmTypeName](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xdmtypename.html): Represents an XSD type name used for type annotations on elements and attributes.
- [XdmValue](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xdmvalue.html): Represents an XDM atomic value — a typed, immutable value from the XPath/XQuery type system.
- [XdmValueType](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xdmvaluetype.html): Enumerates the XDM (XQuery Data Model) value types that can be used for typed index definitions in and .
- [XIncludeErrorKind](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xincludeerrorkind.html): Classifies an so callers (and the XSLT/XQuery engine wirings) can map a failure to the appropriate engine error and tests can assert the cause.
- [XIncludeException](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xincludeexception.html): Thrown when XInclude processing (xi:include resolution) fails.
- [XIncludeLimiter](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xincludelimiter.html): Enforces XInclude expansion resource limits (descent depth, produced-node budget) and carries the xpath1() evaluation timeout. One instance is created per call and threaded through every recursive path, so a bound cannot be silently skipped on one path (the root cause of the resource-safety audit findings). Single-threaded; not reusable.
- [XIncludeOptions](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xincludeoptions.html): Configures XInclude 1.0 (xi:include) processing.
- [XIncludeProcessor](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xincludeprocessor.html): XInclude 1.0 processor: expands xi:include elements with parse="xml" (structural inclusion) or parse="text" (textual inclusion, SP2) and an href, resolving each reference against the in-scope base URI, recursing into included content, and detecting cyclic / over-deep inclusion.
- [XmlDbException](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xmldbexception.html): Base exception for all PhoenixmlDb errors. Catch this type to handle any database-related error in a single handler.
- [XmlDocumentParser](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xmldocumentparser.html): Parses XML content (strings, streams, or readers) into an XDM node tree.
- [XmlSerializer](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xmlserializer.html): Serializes XDM node trees back to XML text, completing the round-trip from (parse) to in-memory XDM to XML output.
- [XPointerEvaluator](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xpointerevaluator.html): Resolves an XInclude xpointer/fragid value against a target , per the W3C XPointer Framework: shorthand (barename), element(), xmlns(), and xpath1() schemes. xpath1() uses System.Xml's built-in XPath 1.0 engine. Returns the selected nodes in document order (empty if nothing is selected); throws a fatal for a grammar-invalid pointer or an invalid xpath1() expression.
- [XQueryException](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xqueryexception.html): Thrown when an XQuery expression fails to parse or encounters a runtime error during execution.
- [XsAnyUri](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xsanyuri.html): Wrapper type for xs:anyURI values, distinguishing them from plain strings at the CLR type level.
- [XsDate](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xsdate.html): Represents an xs:date value with optional timezone and support for extended years.
- [XsDateTime](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xsdatetime.html): Represents an xs:dateTime value with explicit timezone tracking and support for extended years outside the .NET range.
- [XsDuration](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xsduration.html): Represents an xs:duration value with both month and day-time components, preserving the full XSD duration semantics that cannot.
- [XsGDay](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xsgday.html): Represents an xs:gDay value (e.g., ---25), stored as its lexical form.
- [XsGMonth](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xsgmonth.html): Represents an xs:gMonth value (e.g., --12), stored as its lexical form.
- [XsGMonthDay](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xsgmonthday.html): Represents an xs:gMonthDay value (e.g., --12-25), stored as its lexical form.
- [XsGYear](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xsgyear.html): Represents an xs:gYear value (e.g., 2005), stored as its lexical form.
- [XsGYearMonth](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xsgyearmonth.html): Represents an xs:gYearMonth value (e.g., 2005-10), stored as its lexical form.
- [XsTime](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xstime.html): Represents an xs:time value with optional timezone and sub-second precision.
- [XsTypedInteger](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xstypedinteger.html): Tags an integer-typed atomic value with its declared XSD type name so instance of can distinguish between e.g. xs:long, xs:nonNegativeInteger, xs:positiveInteger, etc. Without this wrapper, all integer subtypes collapse to CLR long, so xs:long(1) instance of xs:nonNegativeInteger incorrectly returns true (the value fits in range, but the declared types are siblings under xs:integer, not parent/child).
- [XsTypedString](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xstypedstring.html): Wrapper for XSD string-derived types (xs:normalizedString, xs:token, xs:language, xs:NMTOKEN, xs:Name, xs:NCName, xs:ID, xs:IDREF, xs:ENTITY) that preserves the declared type name for correct instance of semantics.
- [XsUntypedAtomic](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/xsuntypedatomic.html): Wrapper type for xs:untypedAtomic values, distinguishing them from xs:string at the CLR type level.
- [YearMonthDuration](https://phoenixml.dev/api/core/yearmonthduration.html): Represents an xs:yearMonthDuration value as a count of months, implementing correct XML Schema semantics for month-based date arithmetic.
- [AnalyzedTerm](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/analyzedterm.html): A single analyzed term with position information.
- [DelegateMetadataProvider](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/delegatemetadataprovider.html): Adapter that wraps delegate-based metadata resolution into the interface.
- [DepthGuardListener](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/depthguardlistener.html): A parse listener that tracks ANTLR rule-invocation nesting depth and aborts the parse with a catchable once it exceeds . Fires as each rule is entered (before descending into its children) so the runaway recursion stops early. A plain exception is thrown deliberately: ANTLR's DefaultErrorStrategy only catches , so a non-recognition exception propagates straight out of module() rather than triggering error recovery that would resume the descent.
- [ExactUri](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/exacturi.html): A URI wrapper that preserves the exact original string without normalization. adds trailing slashes to scheme://host URIs which breaks namespace URI comparison in XML serialization.
- [FtIsStopWordFunction](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/ftisstopwordfunction.html): ft:is-stop-word($word as xs:string) as xs:boolean Tests if a word is a stop word in the default language.
- [FtScoreFunction](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/ftscorefunction.html): ft:score($node as node()) as xs:double Returns the full-text relevance score of a node from the most recent contains-text evaluation. Score is 0.0 (no match) to 1.0 (perfect match), normalized from BM25.
- [FtStem2Function](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/ftstem2function.html): ft:stem($term as xs:string, $language as xs:string) as xs:string Returns the stemmed form using a language-specific stemmer.
- [FtStemFunction](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/ftstemfunction.html): ft:stem($term as xs:string) as xs:string Returns the stemmed form of a word using the default analyzer.
- [FtThesaurusLookupFunction](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/ftthesauruslookupfunction.html): ft:thesaurus-lookup($term as xs:string, $relationship as xs:string?) as xs:string* Looks up synonyms/related terms in a thesaurus. Basic built-in thesaurus with common synonyms.
- [FtTokenize2Function](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/fttokenize2function.html): ft:tokenize($text as xs:string?, $language as xs:string) as xs:string* Tokenizes text using a language-specific analyzer.
- [FtTokenizeFunction](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/fttokenizefunction.html): ft:tokenize($text as xs:string?) as xs:string* Tokenizes text using the default full-text analyzer. Useful for debugging and understanding how text is analyzed.
- [FullTextAnalysisOptions](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/fulltextanalysisoptions.html): Options controlling full-text analysis behavior.
- [FullTextEngine](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/fulltextengine.html): Full-text search engine powered by Lucene.NET analyzers. Handles tokenization, stemming, and text analysis for XQuery Full-Text queries. Uses Lucene.NET for linguistic analysis (tokenizers, stemmers, stop words) while keeping index storage separate (for LMDB integration).
- [FullTextIndex](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/fulltextindex.html): Full-text inverted index stored in LMDB. Key format: [term_utf8][0x00][container_id:4][document_id:8] Value format: [frequency:2][position_count:2][positions:4*count] The null byte separator allows prefix scanning by term across all documents. Container ID scoping enables per-container full-text queries.
- [HttpDocumentClient](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/httpdocumentclient.html): Shared for fetching XML documents referenced by fn:doc() / xsl:source-document / fn:doc-available() when the resolved URI is http:// or https://.
- [IDocumentResolver](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/idocumentresolver.html): Resolves document URIs to XDM documents for the XQuery fn:doc() and fn:collection() functions.
- [IMetadataProvider](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/imetadataprovider.html): Provides document-level metadata resolution for the XQuery execution engine.
- [PhoenixmlDb.XQuery API Reference](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/index.html): API documentation for the PhoenixmlDb.XQuery library
- [INodeBuilder](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/inodebuilder.html): Extended node store with node creation capabilities. Adds ID allocation, node registration, and namespace interning for functions that construct new XDM trees (e.g., fn:parse-xml, fn:json-to-xml).
- [INodeProvider](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/inodeprovider.html): Provides node resolution for the XQuery execution engine.
- [INodeStore](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/inodestore.html): Adapter that wraps a delegate into the interface. Extended node provider with read-only tree navigation capabilities. Adds namespace resolution and attribute access beyond basic node lookup.
- [IResourceResolver](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/iresourceresolver.html): Custom resource resolver for plugging in external storage backends (S3, database, HTTP, etc.). Return null from any method to fall through to the default resolver.
- [ISchemaProvider](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/ischemaprovider.html): Provides schema awareness to the XQuery and XSLT engines. Public extension point — callers can substitute their own implementation (RelaxNG, Schematron-derived, in-memory, dynamic) by passing it to the constructor.
- [OutputMethod](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/outputmethod.html): Output serialization method for .
- [ParseError](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/parseerror.html): A single parse error with source location information.
- [PolicyEnforcingResolver](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/policyenforcingresolver.html): Wraps an and enforces rules before delegating to the inner resolver or a custom .
- [PostingEntry](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/postingentry.html): A single posting list entry — one term in one document.
- [ResourceAccessDeniedException](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/resourceaccessdeniedexception.html): Thrown when a resource access is denied by the configured .
- [ResourceAccessKind](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/resourceaccesskind.html): Categorizes the type of resource access being requested.
- [ResourcePolicy](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/resourcepolicy.html): Immutable security policy controlling resource access for XSLT and XQuery engines.
- [ResourcePolicyBuilder](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/resourcepolicybuilder.html): Fluent builder for .
- [ResourceResolverBase](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/resourceresolverbase.html): Convenience base class for implementations that only need to handle a subset of resource types.
- [SchemaException](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/schemaexception.html): Thrown when a schema cannot be loaded or compiled. Maps to XQuery error code XQST0059.
- [SchemaValidationException](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/schemavalidationexception.html): Thrown when schema validation fails during a validate expression. Maps to XQuery error code XQDY0027.
- [SerializationOptions](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/serializationoptions.html): Serialization options for XQuery output, corresponding to the declare option output:* declarations in the XQuery prolog.
- [TreeOrdinalAllocator](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/treeordinalallocator.html): Allocates process-global, monotonic tree ordinals stamped onto XdmNode.TreeOrdinal so that XDM document order — the pair (TreeOrdinal, Id) — is total and consistent across nodes drawn from independently-constructed node stores (issue #188).
- [UriRule](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/urirule.html): Defines a scoped access rule for resource URIs.
- [Utf8StringWriter](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/utf8stringwriter.html): StringWriter that reports the desired encoding instead of UTF-16.
- [ValidationMode](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/validationmode.html): Validation mode for the validate expression.
- [XdmDocumentStore](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/xdmdocumentstore.html): An in-memory XDM document store that manages parsed XML documents, node resolution, and namespace interning. Implements both and so it can be passed directly to .
- [XdmShape](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/xdmshape.html): The one place that states how an XDM sequence and an XDM array are told apart at runtime, and the safe operations over that distinction.
- [XQueryAstBuilder](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/xqueryastbuilder.html): Converts an ANTLR parse tree into the XQuery AST node types.
- [XQueryErrorListener](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/xqueryerrorlistener.html): ANTLR error listener that collects parse errors. Implements both lexer and parser error listener interfaces.
- [XQueryFacade](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/xqueryfacade.html): A simple string-in / string-out API for XQuery evaluation.
- [XQueryLexerAdapter](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/xquerylexeradapter.html): An adapter that wraps to manage lexer mode transitions for XQuery direct element constructors.
- [XQueryParseException](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/xqueryparseexception.html): Exception thrown when XQuery parsing fails due to syntax errors in the source text.
- [XQueryParserFacade](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/xqueryparserfacade.html): Public API for parsing XQuery 3.1 source text into an abstract syntax tree (AST).
- [XQueryResultSerializer](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/xqueryresultserializer.html): Serializes XQuery result items (nodes, atomic values, arrays, sequences) to strings.
- [XsdSchemaProvider](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xquery/xsdschemaprovider.html): implementation backed by . Provides full XSD validation, type annotations, and schema-element/attribute matching.
- [PhoenixmlDb.Xslt API Reference](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xslt/index.html): API documentation for the PhoenixmlDb.Xslt library
- [PackageVersionResolution](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xslt/packageversionresolution.html): Strategy for choosing among multiple available versions of an XSLT 3.0 package that all satisfy an xsl:use-package/@package-version range. The XSLT 3.0 REC leaves the choice among matching versions implementation-defined; this enum selects the policy.
- [PreloadedResources](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xslt/preloadedresources.html): Pre-fetched contents for URIs that the engine would otherwise need to fetch over the network synchronously (xsl:import, xsl:include, fn:doc()).
- [QNameNamespaces](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xslt/qnamenamespaces.html): The one place that answers "what namespace URI does this actually carry", and matches two QNames by URI rather than by interned id.
- [SimpleExecutionContext](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xslt/simpleexecutioncontext.html): Minimal execution context that exposes a node store for XDM tree construction.
- [TransformParameterOptions](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xslt/transformparameteroptions.html): Reads the parameter-bearing options of fn:transform — stylesheet-params, template-params and tunnel-params.
- [VendorOptionPackages](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xslt/vendoroptionpackages.html): Extracts XSLT package declarations from the vendor-options map of fn:transform.
- [XdmInMemoryStore](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xslt/xdminmemorystore.html): In-memory backing the XSLT engine's XDM tree. Exposed publicly so callers can construct an XDM source tree externally (e.g. via XmlDocumentParser), pass it into overloads that accept an + store, and then chain the typed result back into another transformation without serializing through XML markup.
- [XmlSourceReader](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xslt/xmlsourcereader.html): Reads an XML file as text, honouring the encoding it declares.
- [XQueryExpressionParser](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xslt/xqueryexpressionparser.html): Adapts XQueryParserFacade to IExpressionParser for XSLT stylesheet parsing.
- [XsltModuleInitializer](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xslt/xsltmoduleinitializer.html): Auto-registers with when the assembly is loaded, so any application that references PhoenixmlDb.Xslt gets fn:transform() wired up automatically — no explicit TransformFunction.Provider = new XsltTransformProvider() call needed.
- [XsltTransformer](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xslt/xslttransformer.html): Primary API for running XSLT transformations in .NET.
- [XsltTransformProvider](https://phoenixml.dev/api/xslt/xslttransformprovider.html): Implements using the public API, enabling fn:transform() from XQuery to run XSLT transformations.

- [Reporting an engine bug](https://phoenixml.dev/guides/reporting-an-engine-bug.html): Narrow a problem to a small reproduction, then turn that reproduction into an XSpec test

## language-reference

- [Language Reference](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/index.html): XPath, XSLT, and XQuery documentation for .NET developers
- [Fallback](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xinclude/fallback.html): Recover from a failed xi:include with xi:fallback substitute content
- [XInclude](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xinclude/index.html): Assemble XML documents from separate files with XInclude 1.0
- [Security and Limits](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xinclude/security-and-limits.html): The resource-safety limits on XIncludeOptions and the resolver extension point
- [Text Inclusion](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xinclude/text-inclusion.html): Splice a resource's raw text into a document with parse="text"
- [XML Inclusion](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xinclude/xml-inclusion.html): Splice a parsed XML document into another with parse="xml"
- [Document Structure](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xml-foundations/document-structure.html): XML elements, attributes, and the document tree explained for JSON developers
- [XML Foundations](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xml-foundations/index.html): XML essentials for developers coming from JSON
- [Namespaces](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xml-foundations/namespaces.html): XML namespaces explained practically — when you need them and how to handle them
- [Unicode and .NET Requirements](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xml-foundations/unicode-and-dotnet.html): ICU globalization requirements, Unicode normalization, collation, and platform setup for PhoenixmlDb
- [Working with JSON](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xml-foundations/working-with-json.html): Parsing, querying, transforming, and outputting JSON with XPath, XSLT, and XQuery
- [The XQuery and XPath Data Model](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xml-foundations/xdm.html): How XPath, XSLT, and XQuery see your XML documents
- [XML vs JSON](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xml-foundations/xml-vs-json.html): Side-by-side comparison of XML and JSON for developers who think in JSON
- [Data Types](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpath/data-types.html): XPath's type system — atomic types, sequences, type casting, and schema interaction
- [Array Functions](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpath/functions/array.html): XPath ordered array operations — like List<T> in .NET
- [Boolean Functions](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpath/functions/boolean.html): XPath boolean construction and logic functions
- [Date and Time Functions](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpath/functions/date-time.html): XPath date/time construction, extraction, formatting, and timezone handling
- [Formatting Functions](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpath/functions/formatting.html): XPath number formatting, date formatting, serialization, and URI handling
- [Higher-Order Functions](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpath/functions/higher-order.html): XPath functions that take functions — map, filter, fold, and more
- [Functions](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpath/functions/index.html): Comprehensive reference for XPath 4.0's 240+ built-in functions
- [Map Functions](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpath/functions/map.html): XPath map operations — key-value data structures like Dictionary in .NET
- [Math Functions](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpath/functions/math.html): XPath math functions — trigonometry, logarithms, exponents, and constants
- [Node Functions](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpath/functions/node.html): XPath node properties, names, namespaces, and document access functions
- [Numeric Functions](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpath/functions/numeric.html): XPath numeric functions — arithmetic, rounding, aggregation
- [Sequence Functions](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpath/functions/sequence.html): XPath sequence operations — filtering, ordering, set operations, scanning
- [String Functions](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpath/functions/string.html): XPath string manipulation, searching, regex, Unicode, and URI functions
- [Type Constructors](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpath/functions/type-constructors.html): XPath type casting and XSD type constructor functions
- [XPath](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpath/index.html): XPath query language for XML — the LINQ of the XML world
- [Operators and Comparisons](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpath/operators.html): XPath arithmetic, comparison, and logical operators with important semantic differences from C#
- [Path Expressions](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpath/path-expressions.html): Navigate XML trees with XPath path expressions, axes, and predicates
- [XPointer](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpointer/index.html): The XPointer Framework that XInclude uses to select a subset of a target document
- [Namespaces and xpath1()](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpointer/namespaces-and-xpath1.html): Bind namespace prefixes with xmlns() and select nodes with the xpath1() scheme, under a wall-clock timeout
- [Shorthand and element()](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xpointer/shorthand-and-element.html): Select an element by its xml:id, or by a root-relative child sequence
- [Conditionals and Error Handling](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xquery/conditionals.html): if/then/else, switch, typeswitch, try/catch, and the otherwise operator
- [Constructors](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xquery/constructors.html): Building new XML elements, attributes, and documents in XQuery
- [Extensibility](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xquery/extensibility.html): Extending XQuery with custom functions, modules, external functions, and .NET integration
- [FLWOR Expressions](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xquery/flwor.html): XQuery's For-Let-Where-Order-Return expressions — LINQ query syntax for XML
- [Advanced FLWOR](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xquery/flwor-advanced.html): Window clauses, count, group by, while, otherwise — advanced FLWOR patterns
- [Full-Text Search](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xquery/full-text.html): XQuery Full-Text — ft:contains, match options, scoring, and search expressions
- [Functions and Modules](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xquery/functions-modules.html): Writing reusable XQuery functions and organizing code into modules
- [XQuery](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xquery/index.html): Query and construct XML with XQuery — SQL for hierarchical data
- [Operators](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xquery/operators.html): XQuery comparison, arithmetic, sequence, and navigation operators
- [Prolog and Declarations](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xquery/prolog.html): XQuery prolog — module declarations, namespace imports, options, and configuration
- [Type System](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xquery/types.html): XQuery types, sequence types, records, enums, union types, and type testing
- [Update Facility](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xquery/update-facility.html): XQuery Update — insert, delete, replace, rename, and transform expressions
- [XQuery vs XSLT](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xquery/xquery-vs-xslt.html): When to use XQuery and when to use XSLT — a practical decision guide
- [Extensibility](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/extensibility.html): Extending XSLT with custom functions, packages, extension instructions, and .NET integration
- [Your First Transform](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/first-transform.html): Hands-on introduction to XSLT — transforming XML to HTML step by step
- [XSLT](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/index.html): Transform XML documents with XSLT — the declarative transformation language
- [String Analysis](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/instructions/analyze-string.html): xsl:analyze-string — regex-based string processing in XSLT
- [Control Flow](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/instructions/control-flow.html): xsl:if, xsl:choose, xsl:switch, xsl:where-populated, xsl:on-empty
- [Copying and Identity Transform](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/instructions/copying-identity.html): xsl:copy, xsl:copy-of, and the identity transform pattern
- [Dynamic Evaluation](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/instructions/dynamic-evaluation.html): xsl:evaluate — runtime XPath evaluation from string expressions
- [Error Handling](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/instructions/error-handling.html): xsl:try/catch, xsl:assert, xsl:fallback — handling errors and asserting conditions
- [User-Defined Functions](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/instructions/functions.html): xsl:function — defining reusable functions callable from XPath expressions
- [Grouping](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/instructions/grouping.html): xsl:for-each-group — all four grouping modes with examples
- [Instructions Reference](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/instructions/index.html): Complete reference for all XSLT 3.0/4.0 instructions
- [Iteration and Sorting](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/instructions/iteration-sorting.html): xsl:for-each, xsl:sort, xsl:perform-sort, xsl:iterate with break and next-iteration
- [Keys and Cross-References](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/instructions/keys.html): xsl:key — indexing documents for fast lookup with key() function
- [Maps, Arrays, and Records](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/instructions/maps-arrays.html): xsl:map, xsl:array, xsl:record, xsl:for-each-member — structured data in XSLT 3.0/4.0
- [Merging](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/instructions/merge.html): xsl:merge — combining multiple sorted input sources into a single output
- [Multiple Output Documents](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/instructions/multiple-outputs.html): xsl:result-document and xsl:output — generating multiple files and controlling serialization
- [Node Construction](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/instructions/node-construction.html): xsl:element, xsl:attribute, xsl:namespace, xsl:document — building nodes with dynamic names
- [Number Formatting](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/instructions/number-formatting.html): xsl:number, xsl:decimal-format, xsl:character-map — numbering and format customization
- [Output Instructions](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/instructions/output.html): xsl:value-of, xsl:text, xsl:comment, xsl:processing-instruction, xsl:sequence, xsl:message
- [Packages](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/instructions/packages.html): xsl:use-package, xsl:accept, xsl:override, xsl:expose — reusable stylesheet libraries
- [Streaming and Accumulators](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/instructions/streaming.html): xsl:source-document, xsl:accumulator, xsl:fork — processing large documents efficiently
- [Variables and Parameters](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/instructions/variables-parameters.html): xsl:variable, xsl:param, static parameters, tunnel parameters, with-param
- [Output Methods](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/output-methods.html): Producing HTML, XML, JSON, CSV, and text from XSLT transforms
- [Template Matching](https://phoenixml.dev/language-reference/xslt/template-matching.html): How XSLT template rules match nodes and produce output — the declarative paradigm shift

## phoenixmldb

- [Containers API](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/api-reference/containers.html): Container creation, configuration, operations, and management
- [Documents API](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/api-reference/documents.html): Document storage, retrieval, metadata, bulk operations, and error handling
- [API Reference](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/api-reference/index.html): PhoenixmlDb .NET API — interfaces, classes, and usage patterns
- [Indexes API](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/api-reference/indexes.html): Index creation, management, statistics, and query optimization
- [Queries API](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/api-reference/queries.html): XQuery execution, parameters, results, explain plans, and prepared queries
- [Resource Policy](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/api-reference/resource-policy.html)
- [Transactions API](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/api-reference/transactions.html): Transaction lifecycle, commit/rollback, error handling, and patterns
- [XSLT API](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/api-reference/xslt-api.html): XsltTransformer .NET API — transform XML with XSLT from C#
- [Configuration](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/configuration.html): Database options, environment variables, logging, and connection strings
- [Core Concepts](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/core-concepts.html): Containers, documents, the XDM, and shredded node storage
- [Database Extensions](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/database-extensions.html): Custom XQuery functions, dbxml:metadata(), and extension development
- [Cluster Mode](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/deployment/cluster-mode.html): Multi-node deployment with Raft consensus, sharding, and distributed transactions
- [Embedded Mode](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/deployment/embedded-mode.html): Run PhoenixmlDb as an in-process library — no separate server needed
- [Deployment](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/deployment/index.html): Run PhoenixmlDb as an embedded library, standalone server, or distributed cluster
- [Server Mode](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/deployment/server-mode.html): Standalone server with gRPC API, authentication, TLS, and Docker deployment
- [Documents & Storage](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/documents-and-storage.html): Storing and retrieving XML and JSON documents in containers
- [PhoenixmlDb](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/index.html): Modern embedded XML/JSON document database for .NET
- [Indexing](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/indexing.html): Path, value, full-text, structural, name, and metadata indexes
- [JSON Support](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/json-support/index.html): Store, query, and index JSON documents with PhoenixmlDb
- [JSON Indexing](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/json-support/json-indexing.html): How JSON documents get full indexing through the XML storage path
- [JSON Queries](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/json-support/json-queries.html): XQuery patterns for querying JSON documents stored in PhoenixmlDb
- [JSON Storage](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/json-support/json-storage.html): How JSON documents are stored, the XML mapping, and storage options
- [LINQ Provider](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/linq-provider.html): Query PhoenixmlDb with LINQ — XML navigation, fluent API, and type mapping
- [Metadata](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/metadata.html): Unlimited namespace-key-value metadata on every document
- [Migration Guide](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/migration-guide.html): Migrate from Berkeley DB XML, eXist-db, MarkLogic, MongoDB, or SQL
- [Mobile Development](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/mobile-development.html): PhoenixmlDb on .NET MAUI, iOS, Android, and offline-first patterns
- [Performance Tuning](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/performance-tuning.html): Query optimization, storage tuning, memory management, and monitoring
- [Transactions](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/transactions.html): ACID transactions with MVCC via LMDB
- [Troubleshooting](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/troubleshooting.html): Common issues and solutions for storage, queries, transactions, and clusters
- [XDM Data Model](https://phoenixml.dev/phoenixmldb/xdm-data-model.html): The XQuery Data Model — how PhoenixmlDb represents documents internally

## tools

- [Crucible](https://phoenixml.dev/tools/crucible.html): Static documentation generator — Markdown to XML to XSLT to HTML
- [Tools](https://phoenixml.dev/tools/index.html): PhoenixmlDb command-line tools and MCP servers
- [phxspec CLI](https://phoenixml.dev/tools/phxspec.html): Command-line XSpec runner — execute XSpec test suites for XSLT with no JVM and no Saxon
- [xquery CLI](https://phoenixml.dev/tools/xquery-cli.html): Command-line XQuery processor — query XML documents from the terminal
- [XQuery MCP Server](https://phoenixml.dev/tools/xquery-mcp.html)
- [xslt CLI](https://phoenixml.dev/tools/xslt-cli.html): Command-line XSLT 3.0/4.0 processor — transform XML documents from the terminal
- [XSLT MCP Server](https://phoenixml.dev/tools/xslt-mcp.html)
